Embed rows in 2 or 3 dimensions (UMAP)

UMAP of the chosen numeric columns (umap-learn's fuzzy graph and a / b curve, PCA start), standardised by default; adds umap_0..umap_n beside the input (null on rows missing a feature).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `UMAPNode` |
| Search words | umap, dimension, embedding, projection |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table containing numeric features |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Embedded** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input plus umap_\* columns, or umap_\* alone |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Columns | Feature columns | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated numeric features; empty auto-detects numeric columns. |
| Columns | Label column | `label_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Optional column excluded from automatic feature detection. |
|   | n_components | `n_components` | Integer | `2` | `2-3` | The run | Output dimensions (2 or 3) |
|   | n_neighbors | `n_neighbors` | Integer | `15` | `2-2147483647` | The run | Neighbours (the row itself included) that shape the layout. |
|   | min_dist | `min_dist` | Number | `0.1` |   | The run | How tightly points may pack together. |
|   | standardise | `standardise` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Scale each feature to z-scores first. |
|   | keep_columns | `keep_columns` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Keep the input columns and add umap_\* beside them. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
